scenes.title: Lizards at Gomat Oasis
scenes.rationale: The approach, battle, aftermath, and overnight rest are one continuous effort to secure the abandoned camp at Gomat.

scenes.title: Akan Returns to Gomat
scenes.rationale: The morning investigation leads directly into Akan's return, his account of the attack, and the recovery of his surviving family.

scenes.title: East into the Nashtkar
scenes.rationale: Leaving Gomat begins a distinct travel situation centered on following the lizard tracks and finding further evidence of unnatural violence.

scenes.title: Crossing Daraar Canyon
scenes.rationale: Scouting, camping above, and crossing the canyon all concern the same physical obstacle despite the overnight date boundary.

scenes.title: The Bloodthirsty Wilds
scenes.rationale: The terrain east of the canyon presents a new situation in which pervasive animal aggression accompanies the approach to the distant fort.

scenes.title: Skeletons at the Ruined Fort
scenes.rationale: The fort survey, skeleton attack, and post-battle investigation form one continuous encounter at the same site with the same immediate goal.
